sentences.en: A fun, family-friendly atmosphere and affordable price tag make this restaurant a great place to take the kids for a night out on the town.

sentences.en: The count nodded affirmatively, and Natasha, at the rapid pace at which she used to run when playing at tag, ran through the ballroom to the anteroom and downstairs into the yard.

sentences.en: Even if he didn't put the same price tag on something material, he didn't begrudge Tim for being the way he was.

sentences.en: The facility now operated by TAG at Farnborough was the first operational airfield in the UK.
